description: Pipecat's aggregator pipeline with OpenAILLMService, one registered function and built-in tracing (conversation and turn spans).
notes: Pipecat 1.16.0 with its built-in tracing (enable_tracing=True, conversation_id). setup_tracing sets the global provider with an OTLP exporter that reads the runner's environment. The pipeline is user aggregator, OpenAILLMService on the mock, and assistant aggregator, with one get_weather function. LLMRunFrame starts the first model call; the function result starts the second. The tool-call turn has no output, and the function call has no span of its own. PipelineTask and WorkerRunner are Pipecat 1.16's names; the deprecated PipelineRunner is not used. No audio services run, so no STT or TTS spans appear.
